messages.content: 四個圓的總周長是多少，其中第一個圓的半徑為5公分，第二個圓的半徑為10公分，第三個圓的半徑為15公分，第四個圓的半徑為20公分？

function.name: calculate_circumference
function.description: Calculates the circumference of a circle with a given radius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circle in the unit given.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the radius. Default is m.

message.content:
四個圓的總周長為  

\[
C_{\text{總}} = 2\pi(5+10+15+20)\ \text{cm}=2\pi\times50\ \text{cm}=100\pi\ \text{cm}
\]

數值上：

\[
100\pi \approx 314.16\ \text{cm}
\]

所以四個圓的總周長大約是 **314.16 公分**。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "四個圓的總周長是多少，其中第一個圓的半徑為5公分，第二個圓的半徑為10公分，第三個圓的半徑為15公分，第四個圓的半徑為20公分？" They want the total circumference of four circles with radii 5 cm, 10 cm, 15 cm, 20 cm. We need to compute circumference for each: C = 2πr. Sum = 2π(5+10+15+20) = 2π*50 = 100π cm. Numerically, π ≈ 3.141592653589793, so 100π ≈ 314.1592653589793 cm. So answer: about 314.16 cm.
